pages: Hamish Prebble, forty-seven, short hair going grey at the temples, a dark green weatherproof jacket zipped to the throat, stands on a dry ridge beside a one-metre telescope dome with one hand on its rail. Middle distance: a control-room doorway, a low fence. Background: Lake Tekapo far below, the southern Milky Way. Thin starlight, two degrees.

Hamish Prebble, forty-seven, short hair grey at the temples, dark green jacket zipped to the throat, bends over a bench inside and looks along one evacuated spectrograph tube. Middle distance: a sealed iodine cell, a row of detectors, coiled cables. Background: the dark dome, red lamp light on the bench.

Hamish Prebble, forty-seven, short hair grey at the temples, dark green jacket zipped to the throat, sits at the desk with one hand resting on a single detector strip lying on the wood. Middle distance: an exposure log, a mug of cold tea. Background: a red-lit window, the dark dome. Red lamplight.

Hamish Prebble, forty-seven, short hair grey at the temples, dark green jacket zipped to the throat, turns the roof open by hand at the slit, one crank handle under his palm. Middle distance: a shutter rail, frost on the ladder. Background: a thick starfield and the Milky Way band. Cold starlight on the metal.

Hamish Prebble, forty-seven, short hair grey at the temples, dark green jacket zipped to the throat, stands under one framed photograph of the ridge sky hanging on the office wall. Middle distance: a desk, a turned-off monitor. Background: a grey window, a coat on a hook. Flat daylight, one red lamp.

Hamish Prebble, forty-seven, short hair grey at the temples, dark green jacket zipped to the throat, reads one printed table of star numbers spread on the desk, one finger down a column. Middle distance: a thick ledger, a pencil. Background: the red-lit window, the dark dome. Red lamplight on the paper.

Hamish Prebble, forty-seven, short hair grey at the temples, dark green jacket zipped to the throat, holds one journal paper up at the desk lamp, the other hand flat on the wood. Middle distance: a coffee cup, a closed laptop. Background: the red window and frost. Warm lamp light on the paper.

Hamish Prebble, forty-seven, short hair grey at the temples, dark green jacket zipped to the throat, works a pencil through a column of his own arithmetic on one sheet of paper. Middle distance: the journal paper, a calculator. Background: the dark control room, one red lamp. Red light on his hands.

Hamish Prebble, forty-seven, short hair grey at the temples, dark green jacket zipped to the throat, leans over one monitor where two curves cross a dark plot window on the screen. Middle distance: the keyboard, a mug. Background: the unlit room, the red desk lamp. Red lamplight and screen glow.

Hamish Prebble, forty-seven, short hair grey at the temples, dark green jacket zipped to the throat, points with one fingertip at a single shallow trough drawn across the screen. Middle distance: a second curve below it, the keyboard. Background: the dark room, the red lamp. Screen glow on his face.

Hamish Prebble, forty-seven, short hair grey at the temples, dark green jacket zipped to the throat, sits close to the monitor at one small bump sitting on the noise of a curve. Middle distance: the flat curve beneath it, a notepad. Background: the dark room, red lamplight. Screen light, four in the morning.

Hamish Prebble, forty-seven, short hair grey at the temples, dark green jacket zipped to the throat, lays one paper calendar flat on the desk and taps one marked block of dates with one finger. Middle distance: a printed observing list, a mug. Background: the red-lit window, the dark dome. Red lamplight.

Hamish Prebble, forty-seven, short hair grey at the temples, dark green jacket zipped to the throat, draws one bump on a pad of paper and copies the same shape again beside it. Middle distance: a ruler, the monitor. Background: the dark control room, one red lamp. Red lamplight on the pad.

Hamish Prebble, forty-seven, short hair grey at the temples, dark green jacket zipped to the throat, runs a pencil down one column of numbers with a single long line struck through it. Middle distance: the printed table, a keyboard. Background: the dark room, red lamplight. Red light on the sheet.

Hamish Prebble, forty-seven, short hair grey at the temples, dark green jacket zipped to the throat, stands by the desk holding one typed sheet in both hands, morning on his face. Middle distance: a chair, the monitor. Background: a lit doorway, coats on hooks. Flat grey daylight and a red lamp.

Hamish Prebble, forty-seven, short hair grey at the temples, dark green jacket zipped to the throat, reaches up in a corridor and takes one large paper poster down off the wall. Middle distance: a noticeboard, a fire extinguisher. Background: frost at the window, a lit doorway. Red corridor lamplight on the poster.

Hamish Prebble, forty-seven, short hair grey at the temples, dark green jacket zipped to the throat, lays one thin printed report on the desk and smooths it flat with one palm. Middle distance: a mug, a closed folder. Background: the red-lit window, the dark dome. Red lamplight on the paper.

Hamish Prebble, forty-seven, short hair grey at the temples, dark green jacket zipped to the throat, crouches at the open spectrograph bench and holds one pale fibre end up between his fingers. Middle distance: the iodine cell, a row of detectors, a red bulb. Background: cable looms, the dark dome. Red lamplight.

Hamish Prebble, forty-seven, short hair grey at the temples, dark green jacket zipped to the throat, writes one figure in a small pocket notebook open flat on his knee. Middle distance: the telescope tube above him, a handrail. Background: the open slit and a thick starfield. Starlight on the notebook.

Hamish Prebble, forty-seven, short hair grey at the temples, dark green jacket zipped to the throat, writes into one open red log book at the desk as the sky goes the colour of old gold. Middle distance: the handwheel, a cold mug. Background: the closed dome, a pale ridge. First light.
